text:
liam: FYI PR #511 preview on Netlify is serving old SDK snippets (looks like cached artifacts). Local `mkdocs serve` shows the new examples. Anyone else seeing stale content after a deploy?
sophia: I saw that too earlier this morning. Netlify sometimes serves from CDN edge cache for a bit. Did you try the preview URL with `?no-cache=1` or append a cache-busting query?
liam: tried `?ts=...` and curl with cache-control: no-cache, still returning the older HTML. Build summary shows `deploy 12345` succeeded but the artifact list contains `asset-2024-03-14.tar.gz` which is older.
nana: small correction: that's me (ana). Two ideas: 1) the preview build might be reading an artifact shard from a stale pipeline cache; 2) the post-build `replace-placeholders.js` script might be reading from `public/_cache` instead of freshly-built site.
sophia: can you paste the netlify build snippet? I want to scan the logs for `skipCache` flags or `restore-cache` steps.
liam: build log excerpt: ```
11:02:03 AM: Restoring cache from /opt/build/cache
11:02:05 AM: Using cached node_modules
11:02:30 AM: yarn build:docs
11:03:10 AM: Success
11:03:12 AM: Running post-build script: node scripts/replace-placeholders.js
11:03:12 AM: Warning: public/_cache exists, using cached assets
11:03:13 AM: Exit code 0
```
nana: that warning is a smoking gun. The script's logic treats `_cache` as authoritative when present. We should change it to prefer fresh build outputs and only use cache as a last resort.
sophia: low-risk patch: change the script to `if (!fs.existsSync('public/index.html')) use cache else ignore cache` and re-run.
docs-ci: note: Netlify preview failed once earlier due to transient auth when pulling private md includes. Current preview queued for rebuild (deploy 12346).
liam: I'll push a tiny fix that flips the cache precedence and include reproduction steps in the PR description. Can someone review quickly? We're aiming for the afternoon merge window (14:00 PT).
sophia: I can review in 15 minutes. Also add a note in PR checklist about clearing Netlify cache if you see old assets.
nana: optional: include a small script snippet in the docs repo for maintainers: `curl -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' $PREVIEW_URL | grep 'SDK example v'` to verify the snippet version.
liam: added commit, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511/files - changed replace-placeholders.js precedence and added the verify snippet command to the PR body.
docs-ci: rebuild requested by @liam - Netlify preview rebuild queued (deploy 12346).
preview-bot: Preview available: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/12346 (status: building).
sophia: if deploy passes, I can approve and we can merge in the 14:00 slot. If it still pulls cache, we may need to trigger a manual cache clear in Netlify UI.
liam: thanks all. I'll add the quick local repro steps to the PR description as well: `yarn docs:build && node scripts/replace-placeholders.js && python -m http.server -d public 8000` and `curl -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' http://localhost:8000/docs/sdk`.
